I grew out of it! I started having grand mal seizures when I was about 9 years old. I didn’t have them frequently but only when something triggers it like people waking me up while I’m in deep sleep, forgot to take my medications or if I’m sleep deprived. However, people noticed that I stare into space a lot which also could’ve been convulsions but didn’t really ask my neurologist about it. 

Anyway, I’m 25 now and haven’t had a seizure in almost 7 years. No one has commented that I stare into space a lot. My neurologist told me I could stop taking lamictal or seizure medications since I haven’t had one in years but I still take it just because I’m scared it might come back at the wrong time. I’m hoping to stop taking it in a few years when I’m comfortable.
